title: ATS Jobs Feed output
description: One row per job opening, normalized across Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, SmartRecruiters and Recruitee. A board that failed yields one row with an error field.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: Default dataset with all job rows (source, company, title, location, department, url, posted_at, updated_at, id).

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Key-value store record SUMMARY: {boards, jobs} counts for the run.
